messages:
cheng: Heads-up — planning a small autoscale smoothing param change on reserved-gpu pools tonight at 21:30 PT. Target: reduce oscillation for short bursts. Will do a canary on pool 'aurora' (5%) then ramp. Need smoke & rollback coverage. @maria @sam are you available?

maria: I can take smoke after canary. What's the exact config change?

cheng: change is tiny: `autoscaler.smoothing_window_ms` from 15000 -> 30000; and `min_burst` unchanged. Canary will set `canary_percent: 5`. Patch looks like: ```json
{
  "autoscaler": {"smoothing_window_ms": 30000},
  "rollout": {"canary_percent": 5}
}
```

sam: ack. I'll queue the canary. Are we tagging the revision?

cheng: yep, rev `rev-2026-03-17-aurora-1`. deploy-bot will post events. Smoke checklist: 1) run `curl -sS https://aurora-smoke.internal/health` expect `ok` 2) run a 100req/s tail-latency test for 2m 3) check GPU utilization + queue depth in console. Maria can run 1+2, Olivia please watch telemetry.

olivia: I'll watch dashboards, set alert if p95 latency > 1200ms or queue_depth > 10.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy rev-2026-03-17-aurora-1 to reserved-gpu/aurora at 21:30 PT. Canary=5%. Jira=INF-4021.

maria: one question — do we have a fast rollback? what's the command?

cheng: rollback is simple: `rcli rollout cancel --pool aurora --tag rev-2026-03-17-aurora-1` or run the previous revision `rcli rollout apply --pool aurora --tag rev-2026-03-15-aurora-stable`. I've also uploaded a rollback runbook snippet to the deploy ticket.

sam: I'll watch the canary and hit rollback if p95 spikes or error-rate > 0.5% for 2m. I'll post start/end times.

cheng: thumbs up. After canary (21:35 PT) we'll wait 10m then bump to 25% if green, then full ramp at 22:00 PT. If anyone needs earlier abort, just `@sam` or `@cheng`.

olivia: noted. enabling synthetic traffic ramp at +1m after canary start.

deploy-bot: canary started rev-2026-03-17-aurora-1 -> reserved-gpu/aurora (5%). inst: aurora-ct-07.

sam: canary is live. Maria please run the health + 2m tail-latency. Posting progress here.

maria: health ok -> `ok`. tail-latency test (100rps) steady p95=420ms, error-rate 0.02%. GPU util + queue_depth look within expected.

deploy-bot: canary succeeded for rev-2026-03-17-aurora-1 (5%). auto-ramp to 25% started.

sam: canary looks clean. bumping to 25% now. Olivia, keep an eye on p95 and queue depth.

olivia: watching — p95 holding ~450ms, queue_depth <= 6. No alerts.

sam: full ramp scheduled for 22:00 PT if 25% stays healthy. Will abort and run rollback command if thresholds hit.

cheng: thanks all. If everything stays green, I'll mark INF-4021 as deployed and add a short note on the perf change. If anything odd shows up overnight, ping this thread and we'll roll back. :thumbsup:
